newsitem.title: CROATIA: Dull trade at Croatian money market.
newsitem.headline: Dull trade at Croatian money market.

text.p: Dull trade dominated the Croatian money market on Friday as there was little demand for fresh kuna funds, dealers said.
No new borrowings were made and only one bank was granted a 30 million kuna call money loan, to be made on Saturday at the rate of 11 percent.
Insurers rolled over a previous 2 million kuna loan at the steady nine percent rate.
There was no overnight trade on Thursday.

The central bank calculated its kuna midrates for Friday and the week-end slightly weaker at 5.5137 against the dollar and 3.5664 against the mark. -- Zoran Radosavljevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
